Container.Name: ut99-server
Container.Requires: Server data will be downloaded to a subdirectory called "server". If you can help it, don't modify anything in there. You should instead put your addons in the "addons" direcotry, where all configuration files will automatically be moved to as well.

Config.Name: Game Type
Config.Description: Initial game type to be loaded.

Config.Name: Mutators
Config.Description: Mutators you want to load, separated by comma (no spaces). For example: MapVoteLA13.BDBMapVote,WhoPushedMe.WhoPushedMe

Config.Name: Server Data
Config.Description: Server data and addons/configuration files will be stored here.

Config.Name: Game Port
Config.Description: Port used by clients connecting to the server. If this is changed, all of the ports below will need to be recalculated.

Config.Name: Query Port 1
Config.Description: Port used by clients querying server info. (Game Port + 1)

Config.Name: Query Port 2
Config.Description: Port used by clients querying server info. (Game Port + 2)

Config.Name: GameSpy Query Port 1
Config.Description: Port used for querying more detailed server information. (Game Port + 3)

Config.Name: GameSpy Query Port 2
Config.Description: Port used for querying more detailed server information. (Game Port + 4)

Config.Name: LAN Query Port
Config.Description: Port used for queries by LAN clients. (Game Port + 1000)

Config.Name: Server Start Extras
Config.Description: If you need to add any other parameters to the server launch command, put them in this variable. This must start with a question mark (?), as it will be appended to the end of the mutators list in the built server start command.

Config.Name: Server Start Command
Config.Description: If you don't want to use the environment variables to specify map/gametype/mutators/extras, you can just specify the entire server start command here. All of the map/gametype/mutators/extras environment variables will be ignored.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID to run the container as.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID to run the container as.

Config.Name: Skip Install
Config.Description: If you don't want to download/update your server files, set this to true. I assume you know what you're doing. Maybe manually installing your own server to the /data/server directory or something? I don't know.
